title: Honey BBQ Chicken Tenders with White Sauce
title_ms: Honey BBQ Chicken Tenders dengan Sos Putih
description: Crispy chicken tenders tossed in a smoky honey BBQ glaze, served with a cool yogurt-mayo white sauce — an upgrade on the classic hot chicken tenders.
description_ms: Chicken tenders yang crispy digaulkan dalam saduran madu BBQ yang smoky, dihidang dengan sos putih yogurt-mayo yang segar.
steps: Moisten 1 cup chicken fried flour with a little water to make a wet dip; keep the rest dry.
Dip chicken tenders in the wet flour, then coat in the dry flour.
Deep-fry in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
Mix 1 tbsp paprika powder, 1 tbsp cayenne pepper, 0.5 tbsp chilli flakes, 0.5 tbsp garlic powder and 1 tbsp brown sugar in a bowl.
Ladle hot frying oil over the spice mix to bloom the spices.
Add BBQ sauce (to taste) and 0.5 tbsp honey; stir until a thick, glossy glaze forms.
Toss the fried chicken in the glaze until evenly coated.
[White sauce] Mix 3 tbsp plain yogurt, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a squeeze of lemon, black pepper, 2 crushed garlic cloves and a pinch of salt.
steps_ms: Basahkan 1 cawan tepung goreng ayam dengan sedikit air untuk jadi celupan basah; baki kekalkan kering.
Celup chicken tenders dalam tepung basah, kemudian salut dengan tepung kering.
Goreng dalam minyak panas sehingga golden crispy; toskan.
Gaul 1 sudu serbuk paprika, 1 sudu cayenne pepper, setengah sudu cili flakes, setengah sudu garlic powder dan 1 sudu brown sugar dalam mangkuk.
Tuang minyak goreng yang betul-betul panas ke atas campuran rempah untuk bloom.
Masukkan sos barbeque (secukupnya) dan setengah sudu madu; gaul sehingga jadi saduran pekat berkilat.
Toss ayam goreng dalam saduran sehingga rata.
[Sos putih] Gaul 3 sudu yogurt original, 3 sudu mayo, perahan lemon, black pepper, 2 ulas bawang putih yang dihancurkan dan sedikit garam.
